summary.zh: 一个黑白线稿的帆布收纳袋。拖动拉链头，齿链沿曲线一颗颗分开、缝越张越大，拉片跟着手甩；拉到一半能从缝里看到一张优惠券的边，拉到底它整张升起来。没拉到底就松手，拉链会弹回去。
summary.en: A black-and-white line-art canvas pouch. Drag the zipper pull and the teeth part one by one along a curve while the pull tab swings; halfway you glimpse the edge of a coupon, all the way and it rises out. Let go too early and the zipper springs back shut.

technique.zh: 缝的宽度 = 最大宽度 × smoothstep(离拉链头的距离) × smoothstep(离起点的距离)，上唇往上抬、下唇往下压，每帧重算两条曲线；齿沿曲线排、按切线旋转，合上的部分上下交错咬合。拉链头是弹簧（跟手时硬、弹回去时软），拉片是挂在拉链头上的单摆。优惠券被裁在“下唇上方”的区域里，所以只会从缝里出来。
technique.en: Gap width = max × smoothstep(distance to the slider) × smoothstep(distance to the start stop); the upper lip lifts and the lower lip drops, both curves rebuilt every frame. Teeth sit along the curves rotated to the tangent and interlock where closed. The slider is a spring (stiff while dragging, softer when snapping back) and the pull tab is a pendulum hanging from it. The coupon is clipped to the area above the lower lip, so it can only come out of the gap.

desc.zh: 拉开后缝最宽多少（SVG 单位）
拉过这个比例松手就自动拉到底
desc.en: past this fraction it auto-completes on release

desc.zh: 拉链头跟手的弹簧刚度
弹回去的弹簧刚度（越小越慢）

adapt.zh: 适合优惠码、彩蛋、隐藏答案、礼品卡这种“拉开看看”的场景。拉链头是 role="slider"，键盘 ← → / Home / End / 空格都能操作。
adapt.en: Good for coupon codes, easter eggs, hidden answers or gift cards. The pull is a role="slider": ← → / Home / End / Space all work.
